profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | M.S. Cybersecurity | Small Business Owner
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer | Cybersecurity Professional | Small Business Owner | Marine Corps Veteran
I am a Marine Corps veteran with a BS in Computer Science and Engineering and an MS in Cybersecurity. With a strong foundation in software development and security, I specialize in architecting and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions for organizations with a combined user base of over five million customers.

In my role as a Principal Software Developer, I design and develop enterprise web applications with a focus on HTML, SCSS, UI/UX design, Azure B2C custom policies, Azure function applications, Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Oracle and other third-party products. Recently, I have expanded my expertise into UI/UX design using Figma, creating intuitive, user-friendly interfaces that enhance customer experiences.

Beyond the tech world, I’ve ventured into entrepreneurship as a small business owner, launching a veteran-owned laser engraving business. This new journey has allowed me to apply my technical problem-solving skills in a creative and hands-on way—designing and producing custom-engraved products that bring unique visions to life.

My career is driven by a passion for innovation, whether it’s developing scalable digital identity solutions, enhancing user experiences, or exploring new ways to blend technology and craftsmanship. I am always looking for opportunities to grow, collaborate, and push boundaries in both software development and business.

Let’s connect and explore ways to innovate together!

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer (CIAM) leading identity strategy with deep expertise in Azure AD B2C, Azure Cloud, and DevSecOps. Designs and delivers secure, scalable identity platforms, embedding security across architecture, authentication flows, and deployment pipelines.

Builds cloud-native identity services using C# and Azure Functions, with additional experience in Java Spring Boot APIs. Hands-on with Kubernetes for containerized deployment and orchestration, and Keycloak for modern identity and access management solutions.

Full-stack experience across HTML, JavaScript, SASS, React Router, and TailwindCSS, delivering mobile-first, secure-by-design applications. Strong UI/UX foundation using Figma, focused on balancing usability with practical cybersecurity principles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer specializing in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with hands-on experience in Azure AD B2C custom policies and secure identity implementations. Designed and built authentication and authorization solutions with a strong focus on cybersecurity and system design.

Worked extensively in Azure Cloud environments, using Azure DevOps and Pipelines to build and deploy secure, scalable applications. Developed backend services and APIs using C#, Java (Spring Boot), and Python.

Full-stack experience with JavaScript, React Router, HTML, CSS, SASS, and TailwindCSS, delivering mobile-first, secure-by-design web applications. Utilized Kubernetes for containerized deployments and Keycloak for identity and access management solutions.

Strong foundation in Bash/Shell scripting, YAML-based configuration, and unit testing. Applied UI/UX design principles using Figma to build user-friendly interfaces aligned with modern security requirements.

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description:
I own and operate a veteran-owned laser engraving business focused on high-quality, custom work for both individuals and businesses. I specialize in engraving wood, acrylic, glass, and other materials to create personalized products, branded items, and signage.

I handle projects end-to-end—from design through production—ensuring each piece is accurate, consistent, and built to last. Most of my work is custom, so I work directly with customers to understand what they need and deliver something that matches their vision.

What I focus on:
	•	Custom engraving for gifts, branding, and signage
	•	Clean, precise work across multiple materials
	•	Reliable turnaround and clear communication
	•	Practical designs that look good and hold up over time

If you have an idea or need something custom, I’m always open to discussing new projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Laser Engraving · Customer Service · Sales · Accounting · Adobe Illustrator
